en: Dependent on a state that is included (pariyāpanna), a state that is not included (na-apariyāpanna) arises by way of the root-condition (hetu-paccaya). Dependent on a state that is not included, a state that is not included arises by way of the root-condition.
Dependent on a state that is not included, a state that is not included arises by way of the root-condition. [Dependent on] a state that is not included...
Dependent on states that are both included and not included, there arise states that are neither included nor not included by way of the root condition.
Dependent on a state that is both included and not included, there arises a state that is not included by way of the root condition. (Abbreviated.
Under the root [condition] there are five; under the object [condition], two ... pe ... under the non-disappearance [condition], five.
